name: Certemy
short_description: License tracking and compliance platform for healthcare organizations. Automated PSV, CE tracking, multi-state compliance, and audit-ready reporting from $8/employee/month.
description: Certemy is a license tracking and primary source verification platform that helps healthcare organizations automate compliance management for professional licenses, certifications, and credentials. The platform provides real-time tracking, automated renewals, and compliance reporting across all 50 states.

core_features.name: Automated License Tracking
core_features.description: Real-time monitoring of professional licenses across all 50 states with automated expiration alerts and renewal reminders

core_features.name: Primary Source Verification
core_features.description: Direct verification of licenses, certifications, and credentials from issuing authorities with documented audit trails

core_features.name: Continuing Education Tracking
core_features.description: CE credit tracking, requirements mapping by state and license type, and completion documentation

core_features.name: Compliance Workflows
core_features.description: Configurable workflows for license renewal, document collection, and approval processes

core_features.name: Multi-State Compliance
core_features.description: Centralized management of license requirements across multiple states for mobile workforce and telehealth providers

core_features.name: Audit-Ready Reporting
core_features.description: Comprehensive compliance reports, license verification documentation, and audit preparation tools

mental_health_specific: Psychology license (50 states) tracking and verification
CEU tracking for mental health continuing education

pricing.notes: Pricing based on employee count with volume discounts for 500+ employees. Annual contracts available.

integrations.name: State Licensing Boards
integrations.description: Direct connections for primary source verification

best_for: Healthcare staffing agencies with mobile workforce
Organizations with complex CE compliance requirements
Practices needing automated license renewal tracking
not_ideal_for: Single-state practices with simple license needs
